title: 单主体室内半身像
user_input: 一个穿黑色风衣的年轻女性站在室内窗边，冷色灯光，半身中景，略微侧身。
plain_prompt: A young woman in a black trench coat stands by an indoor window, cool lighting, medium half-body shot, slightly turned.
structured_prompt: Scene: indoor portrait near a window. Subject count: 1. Subject 1: young woman, black trench coat, half-body medium shot, slightly turned torso, keep identity stable. Composition: subject near the window, cool indoor light, clean frame, no extra people. Priority: subject identity and pose first, then lighting mood.

title: 单主体户外远景
user_input: 一个戴帽子的男人站在海边防波堤上，远景，阴天，人物不要太大。
plain_prompt: A man wearing a cap stands on a seaside breakwater, wide shot, cloudy weather, keep the figure small.
structured_prompt: Scene: seaside breakwater, overcast daylight. Subject count: 1. Subject 1: man with a cap, placed small in a wide frame, standing on the breakwater. Composition: wide shot, horizon visible, figure should not dominate frame. Priority: scale and placement before style.

title: 单主体桌边静态图
user_input: 一个穿浅灰毛衣的女孩坐在木桌旁，暖色台灯，安静阅读，静止构图。
plain_prompt: A girl in a light gray sweater sits by a wooden desk under a warm desk lamp, quietly reading, static composition.
structured_prompt: Scene: quiet reading corner. Subject count: 1. Subject 1: girl in a light gray sweater, seated beside a wooden desk, reading calmly. Lighting: warm desk lamp. Composition: static, stable medium shot, no motion cues. Priority: keep seated pose and calm atmosphere.

title: 双人物面对面
user_input: 两个人面对面站着，一个靠前，一个靠后，室内走廊，人物关系要清楚。
plain_prompt: Two people stand facing each other in an indoor corridor, one in front and one behind, their relationship should be clear.
structured_prompt: Scene: indoor corridor. Subject count: 2. Subject 1: foreground person, larger in frame, facing Subject 2. Subject 2: background person, smaller in frame, clearly separated in depth. Composition: preserve front-back layering and face-to-face relation, no overlap that hides either subject.

title: 双人物同桌交谈
user_input: 一男一女坐在咖啡桌两侧交谈，女人更靠镜头，男人稍远一点。
plain_prompt: A man and a woman sit on opposite sides of a coffee table talking, the woman is closer to camera and the man is a bit farther back.
structured_prompt: Scene: cafe table conversation. Subject count: 2. Subject 1: woman closer to camera, seated on one side of the table. Subject 2: man slightly farther back on the opposite side. Composition: maintain two-seat relation across the table, preserve depth separation, no third person.

title: 双人物追逐前后关系
user_input: 一个警察在前，一个嫌疑人在后面回头看，巷子里，前后关系要明确。
plain_prompt: A police officer in front and a suspect behind looking back in an alley, keep the front-back relation clear.
structured_prompt: Scene: narrow alley chase still. Subject count: 2. Subject 1: police officer in front, dominant in frame. Subject 2: suspect behind, looking back. Composition: strong front-back hierarchy, alley depth visible, no subject merge.

title: 前中后景室内构图
user_input: 前景是人物，中景是一张桌子，后景有窗户和暖灯，空间层次要清楚。
plain_prompt: A person in the foreground, a table in the midground, and a window with warm light in the background, with clear spatial depth.
structured_prompt: Scene: layered indoor composition. Object count: 3. Foreground: person. Midground: table. Background: window and warm light. Composition: preserve foreground-midground-background separation, keep each object readable, no flattening of space.

title: 工作台复杂构图
user_input: 画面里有前景人物、中景工作台、后景显示器和工具架，工业工作室氛围。
plain_prompt: A foreground person, a midground workbench, and background monitors and tool racks in an industrial studio.
structured_prompt: Scene: industrial studio. Object count: 4. Foreground: one person. Midground: workbench. Background: monitors and tool rack. Composition: layered industrial workspace, maintain object roles clearly, avoid clutter swallowing the main subject.

title: 街头摊位多元素
user_input: 前景是顾客，中景是摊位，后景是街道和招牌，夜景，元素很多但要清楚。
plain_prompt: In the foreground is a customer, in the midground a street stall, and in the background a street with signs, at night, many elements but still clear.
structured_prompt: Scene: night street stall. Object count: 3 major layers. Foreground: customer. Midground: stall. Background: street and signs. Composition: keep crowded atmosphere but readable layering, preserve stall as center anchor, avoid losing customer silhouette.

title: 产品界面海报
user_input: 一个人站在科技展台前，旁边有发光产品屏和简洁界面文字，整体像发布会海报。
plain_prompt: A person stands in front of a tech booth with a glowing product screen and clean interface text, like a launch poster.
structured_prompt: Scene: tech launch poster. Subject count: 1 person plus display panel. Composition: person beside a glowing product screen, with clean UI-like text blocks kept readable and minimal. Priority: poster layout, readable panel area, no cluttered typography.

title: 控制室屏幕信息
user_input: 一个工程师站在控制室里，后面有多块屏幕和状态文字，信息要整齐。
plain_prompt: An engineer stands in a control room with multiple screens and status text behind, the information should look organized.
structured_prompt: Scene: control room. Subject count: 1 engineer with multiple information screens behind. Composition: engineer in foreground, screens aligned in background, status text blocks orderly and readable-looking, no random extra UI.

title: 地图指示屏
user_input: 一个旅客站在地铁站地图屏前，屏幕上有路线信息和站点文字，构图简洁。
plain_prompt: A traveler stands in front of a subway map display with route information and station text, simple composition.
structured_prompt: Scene: subway station guidance board. Subject count: 1 traveler and 1 map display. Composition: traveler near the map board, route information area clearly reserved, clean signage layout, no extra crowd. Priority: signage readability and simple composition.
